segments.ja478:1.1: Dūte te brahme [dūte brāhmaṇa (ka.)] pāhesiṃ, gaṅgātīrasmi jhāyato;
segments.ja478:1.3: Tesaṃ puṭṭho na byākāsi, dukkhaṃ guyhamataṃ [guyhaṃ mataṃ (sī.), tuyhaṃ mataṃ (syā. ka.)] nu te.
segments.ja478:2.3: Mā kho naṃ tassa akkhāhi, yo taṃ dukkhā na mocaye.
segments.ja478:3.1: Yo tassa [yo ca tathā (pī.)] dukkhajātassa, ekaṅgamapi bhāgaso [ekantamapi bhāsato (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja478:5.1: Api ce maññatī poso, ñāti mitto sakhāti vā;
segments.ja478:5.3: Yo pubbe sumano hutvā, pacchā sampajjate diso.
segments.ja478:6.1: Yo attano dukkhamanānupuṭṭho, pavedaye jantu akālarūpe;
segments.ja478:6.3: Ānandino tassa bhavantimittā [bhavanta’ mittā (sī. pī.)], hitesino tassa dukhī bhavanti.
segments.ja478:7.1: Kālañca ñatvāna tathāvidhassa, medhāvīnaṃ ekamanaṃ viditvā;
segments.ja478:7.3: Akkheyya tibbāni [tippāni (sī. syā. pī.)] parassa dhīro, saṇhaṃ giraṃ atthavatiṃ pamuñce.
segments.ja478:8.1: Sace ca jaññā avisayhamattano, na te hi mayhaṃ [nāyaṃ nīti mayha (sī. pī.)] sukhāgamāya;
segments.ja478:8.3: Ekova tibbāni saheyya dhīro, saccaṃ hirottappamapekkhamāno.
segments.ja478:10.5: Te me naṭṭhā mahārāja, tasmā socāmahaṃ bhusaṃ.
segments.ja478:11.3: Nālaṃ dukkhā pamocetuṃ, tasmā tesaṃ na byāhariṃ.
segments.ja478:12.3: Alaṃ dukkhā pamocetuṃ, tasmā tuyhaṃ pavedayiṃ.

lines: Tattha dukkhaṃ guyhamataṃ nu teti kiṃ nu kho, brāhmaṇa, yaṃ tava dukkhaṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ te guyhameva mataṃ, na aññassa ācikkhitabbanti.
Taṃ sutvā mahāsatto “mahārāja, dukkhaṃ nāma harituṃ samatthasseva ācikkhitabbaṃ, na aññassā”ti vatvā satta gāthā abhāsi –
Mā kho naṃ tassa akkhāhi, yo taṃ dukkhā na mocaye.
“Api ce maññatī poso, ñāti mitto sakhāti vā;
Yo pubbe sumano hutvā, pacchā sampajjate diso.
Ānandino tassa bhavanti mittā, hitesino tassa dukhī bhavanti.
Akkheyya tibbāni parassa dhīro, saṇhaṃ giraṃ atthavatiṃ pamuñce.
“Sace ca jaññā avisayhamattano, na te hi mayhaṃ sukhāgamāya;
Ekova tibbāni saheyya dhīro, saccaṃ hirottappamapekkhamāno”ti.
Dubbijānataraṃ tatoti tato tiracchānagatavassitatopi dubbijānataraṃ, tasmā tathato ajānitvā harituṃ asamatthassa attano dukkhaṃ na kathetabbamevāti.
Tathāvidhassāti paṇḍitapurisaṃ attanā saddhiṃ ekamanaṃ viditvā tathāvidhassa ācikkheyya.
Saceti yadi attano dukkhaṃ avisayhaṃ attano vā paresaṃ vā purisakārena atekicchaṃ jāneyya.
Te hīti te eva lokapaveṇikā, aṭṭhalokadhammāti attho.

Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – atha ayaṃ lokapaveṇī na mayhaṃ eva sukhāgamāya uppannā, aṭṭhahi lokadhammehi parimutto nāma natthi, evaṃ sante sukhameva patthentena parassa dukkhāropanaṃ nāma na yuttaṃ, netaṃ hirottappasampannena kattabbaṃ, atthi ca me hirī ottappanti saccaṃ saṃvijjamānaṃ attani hirottappaṃ apekkhamānova aññassa anārocetvā ekova tibbāni saheyya dhīroti.
Evaṃ mahāsatto sattahi gāthāhi rañño dhammaṃ desetvā attano ācariyadhanassa pariyesitabhāvaṃ dassento catasso gāthā abhāsi –
Te me naṭṭhā mahārāja, tasmā socāmahaṃ bhusaṃ.
Nālaṃ dukkhā pamocetuṃ, tasmā tesaṃ na byāhariṃ.
Alaṃ dukkhā pamocetuṃ, tasmā tuyhaṃ pavedayin”ti.
Te meti te satta nikkhā mama gaṅgaṃ tarantassa naṭṭhā, gaṅgāyaṃ patitā.
Anuvicintitāti “nālaṃ ime maṃ dukkhā mocetun”ti mayā ñātā.
Tasmāti tena kāraṇena tesaṃ attano dukkhaṃ nācikkhiṃ.
Rājā tassa dhammakathaṃ sutvā “mā cintayi, brāhmaṇa, ahaṃ te ācariyadhanaṃ dassāmī”ti dviguṇadhanamadāsi.
Tattha jātarūpamayeti te suvaṇṇassa catuddasa nikkhe jātarūpamayeyeva adāsi, na yassa vā tassa vā suvaṇṇassāti attho.
